name: software-writer-extension-setup
description: One-time setup skill that explores a project's codebase, drafts project-specific overlay content conversationally, and provisions the delivery plumbing needed to extend the software-writer plugin's writing-code, writing-tests, and writing-docs skills. Includes a re-sync mode that audits existing overlays for drift. Long plugin and skill names are intentional to prevent accidental invocation.
